description: 说明所有可能受主体重大影响的价值链劳动者是否已纳入ESRS 2披露范围。

labels.en: All value chain workers  who can be materially impacted by undertaking are included in scope of disclosure under ESRS 2
labels.zh: 可能受重大影响的价值链劳动者纳入披露范围

description: 描述价值链中受重大影响的劳动者类型，包括就业形态和所处环节。

labels.en: Description of types of value chain workers subject to material impacts
labels.zh: 受重大影响的价值链劳动者类型

description: 说明因主体自身运营或通过价值链而受重大影响的价值链劳动者类型。

labels.en: Type of value chain workers subject to material impacts by own operations or through value chain
labels.zh: 因自身运营或价值链而受影响的价值链劳动者类型

description: 披露价值链中存在童工或强迫劳动重大风险的地理区域或商品。

labels.en: Disclosure of geographies or commodities for which there is significant risk of child labour, or of forced or compulsory labour, among workers in undertaking’s value chain
labels.zh: 童工或强迫劳动重大风险的地理区域与商品

description: 披露价值链劳动者中重大负面影响是否已经发生，以及发生的情形。

labels.en: Material negative impacts occurrence (value chain workers)
labels.zh: 价值链劳动者重大负面影响的出现情况

description: 描述产生积极影响的活动，以及受到或可能受到积极影响的价值链劳动者类型。

labels.en: Description of activities that result in positive impacts and types of value chain workers  that are positively affected or could be positively affected
labels.zh: 产生积极影响的活动及受益价值链劳动者类型

description: 描述因对价值链劳动者的影响和依赖所产生的重大风险与机遇。

labels.en: Description of material risks and opportunities arising from impacts and dependencies on  value chain workers
labels.zh: 价值链劳动者相关重大风险与机遇

description: 说明主体是否以及如何形成对特定特征、特定情境或特定活动的价值链劳动者可能面临更高伤害风险的理解。

labels.en: Disclosure of whether and how the undertaking has developed an understanding of how workers with particular characteristics, those working in particular contexts, or those undertaking particular activities may be at greater risk of harm.
labels.zh: 特定特征或情境价值链劳动者更高风险的理解

description: 说明价值链劳动者相关重大风险与机遇中，哪些涉及特定群体。

labels.en: Disclosure of which of material risks and opportunities arising from impacts and dependencies on value chain workers  are impacts on specific groups
labels.zh: 重大风险与机遇对应的特定群体（价值链）
